## Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)  # AI-EDIT(2026-06-23): tidyverse-default — consolidated core library() calls into library(tidyverse)
```

## Load Data
# I asked AI to read the CSV file and it generated the following code. I verified that the file path is correct and that the data loads without errors.
```{r}
my_data <- read_csv("examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Inspect

```{r}
dim(my_data)
names(my_data)
glimpse(my_data)
colSums(is.na(my_data))
```

## Summarize

Replace this example with your own summary if you choose a different question.

```{r}
education_summary <- my_data |>
  filter(!is.na(BMI), !is.na(Weight), !is.na(Waist), !is.na(Education), !is.na(Marital), !is.na(PIR), !is.na(EducationClean), !is.na(MaritalClean), !is.na(WHtR)) |>
  group_by(Education) |>
  select(BMI, Weight, Waist, Education, Marital, PIR, EducationClean, MaritalClean, WHtR)

education_summary
```

## Function

```{r}
BMI_mean <- mean(my_data$BMI, na.rm = TRUE)
```

## Save Output

```{r}
dir.create("assignments/assignment02-r-with-ai/submission/output", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(education_summary, "assignments/assignment02-r-with-ai/submission/output/summary_table.csv")
```
